Voetbalvereniging | nickname = ''De Kanaries'' (The Canaries) | founded = 23 February 1924 | ground = [[Stayen]] | capacity = 14,600[https://web.archive.org/web/20130714122525/http://www.stayen.com/nl/business/vergaderzalen-huren/algemeen Het Stayen] stayen.com (last check 30 March 2018) | chairman = David Meekers | owner = [[DMM.com]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = Frédéric De Meyer | league = {{Belgian football updater|SintTruidenseVV}} | season = {{Belgian football updater|SintTruidenseVV2}} | position = {{Belgian football updater|SintTruidenseVV3}} | current = 2025–26 Sint-Truidense V.V. season | website = {{URL|https://www.stvv.com/en|stvv.com}} | pattern_la1 = _stvv2324h | pattern_b1 = _stvv2324h | pattern_ra1 = _stvv2324h | pattern_sh1 = _stvv2122h | pattern_so1 = _bluetops | leftarm1 = FFFF00 | body1 = FFFF00 | rightarm1 = FFFF00 | shorts1 = 0000FF | socks1 = FFFF00 | pattern_la2 = _stvv2324a | pattern_b2 = _stvv2324a | pattern_ra2 = _stvv2324a | pattern_sh2 = _stvv2223a | pattern_so2 = _stvv2223a | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = | caption = }} '''[[Koninklijke]] Sint-Truidense Voetbalvereniging''' ({{IPA|nl|ˈkoːnɪŋkləkə sɪnˈtrœydə(n)sə ˈvudbɑlvərˌeːnəɣɪŋ}}), commonly known as '''Sint-Truiden''' or '''STVV''' ({{IPA|nl|ˌɛsteːveːˈveː|pron}}) or by their nickname '''De Kanaries''' ({{IPA|nl|də kaːˈnaːris|pron}}), is a Belgian professional [[Association football|football]] club located in the city of [[Sint-Truiden]], [[Limburg (Belgium)|Limburg]] that plays in the [[Belgian Pro League]], the highest tier of football in Belgium. Founded in 1924 with [[Football in Belgium#Matricule numbers|matricule number]] 373, STVV has played their home games at the [[Stayen]] since 1927. The club's best league finish was second in [[Belgian First Division 1965–66|1965–66]]. They also reached the final of the [[Belgian Cup]] twice."}}
